verdict_reason: The single fulfilment-id-to-role map is a sound owner for party roles and the UK rule is preserved, but rolesOfParty is a near-twin of roleOfParty whose name hides that it builds the roles to save from posted input.

todos.issue: rolesOfParty(context, postedRoles) (line 82) is one letter from roleOfParty (line 47) and reads as 'the roles the party holds', but it returns the roles a journey-mode save carries: the party's own role plus the posted roles its address type offers. The name hides that it filters posted input, and the pair invites one being called for the other
todos.fix: Must: the function's name says it returns the roles to save, built from the party's own role and the posted roles its side offers, and cannot be misread as roleOfParty. One way: rename it rolesToSaveForParty (or keepOwnAndOfferedRoles) across journey-registry.js, add.controller.js, journey-registry.test.js and src/server/app/docs/features.md
